 1006 | // Helper to extract indent level from vNode or parent paragraph
 1007 | function getIndentLevel(
 1008 |   vNode: VNodeType | null,
 1009 |   parentVNode: VNodeType | null = null
 1010 | ): number {
 1011 |   // Check margin-left style which indicates indent level
 1012 |   const marginLeft =
 1013 |     vNode?.properties?.style?.['margin-left'] ||
 1014 |     parentVNode?.properties?.style?.['margin-left']
 1015 |
 1016 |   if (marginLeft) {
 1017 |     // Parse margin-left value (e.g., "24px", "48px")
 1018 |     const match = marginLeft.match(MARGIN_NUMBER_REGEX)
 1019 |     if (match) {
 1020 |       const px = Number.parseInt(match[1], 10)
 1021 |       // Assuming 24px per indent level in Plate
 1022 |       // Subtract 1 because Plate uses indent=1 for first level, but Word uses level=0
 1023 |       const plateIndent = Math.round(px / 24)
 1024 |       return Math.max(0, plateIndent - 1)
 1025 |     }
 1026 |   }
 1027 |
 1028 |   return 0
 1029 | }

 1005 |
 1006 | // Helper to extract indent level from vNode or parent paragraph
 1007 | function getIndentLevel(
 1008 |   vNode: VNodeType | null,
 1009 |   parentVNode: VNodeType | null = null
 1010 | ): number {
 1011 |   // Check margin-left style which indicates indent level
 1012 |   const marginLeft =
 1013 |     vNode?.properties?.style?.['margin-left'] ||
 1014 |     parentVNode?.properties?.style?.['margin-left']
 1015 |
 1016 |   if (marginLeft) {
 1017 |     // Parse margin-left value (e.g., "24px", "48px")
 1018 |     const match = marginLeft.match(MARGIN_NUMBER_REGEX)
 1019 |     if (match) {
 1020 |       const px = Number.parseInt(match[1], 10)
 1021 |       // Assuming 24px per indent level in Plate
 1022 |       // Subtract 1 because Plate uses indent=1 for first level, but Word uses level=0
 1023 |       const plateIndent = Math.round(px / 24)
 1024 |       return Math.max(0, plateIndent - 1)
 1025 |     }
 1026 |   }
 1027 |
 1028 |   return 0
 1029 | }
 1030 |
 1031 | export async function convertVTreeToXML(
 1032 |   docxDocumentInstance: DocxDocumentInstance,
 1033 |   vTree: VTree | null,
 1034 |   xmlFragment: XMLBuilderType
 1035 | ): Promise<XMLBuilderType | string> {
 1036 |   if (!vTree) {
 1037 |     return ''
 1038 |   }
 1039 |   if (Array.isArray(vTree) && vTree.length) {
 1040 |     /* eslint-disable no-await-in-loop -- DOCX XML fragments must be built in document order */
 1041 |     for (let index = 0; index < vTree.length; index++) {
 1042 |       const vNode = vTree[index]
 1043 |       await convertVTreeToXML(docxDocumentInstance, vNode, xmlFragment)
 1044 |     }
 1045 |     /* eslint-enable no-await-in-loop */
 1046 |   } else if (isVNode(vTree)) {
 1047 |     await findXMLEquivalent(docxDocumentInstance, vTree as VNodeType, xmlFragment)
 1048 |   } else if (isVText(vTree)) {
 1049 |     const text = vTree.text
 1050 |     if (!text || !text.trim()) {
 1051 |       return xmlFragment
 1052 |     }
 1053 |     const paragraphFragment = await xmlBuilder.buildParagraph(
 1054 |       vTree,
 1055 |       {},
 1056 |       docxDocumentInstance
 1057 |     )
 1058 |     xmlFragment.import(paragraphFragment)
 1059 |   }
 1060 |   return xmlFragment
 1061 | }

  895 |       const indentLevel = getIndentLevel(vNode)
  896 |
  897 |       // Get existing numbering ID for this type+level, if any
  898 |       const { lastListNumberingId: existingId } = getListTracking(
  899 |         vNode.tagName,
  900 |         indentLevel
  901 |       )
  902 |
  903 |       let numberingId: number
  904 |       if (existingId !== null) {
  905 |         // Reuse existing numbering for this type+level
  906 |         numberingId = existingId
  907 |       } else {
  908 |         // Create a new numbering ID for a new list sequence
  909 |         numberingId = docxDocumentInstance.createNumbering(vNode.tagName, vNode.properties)
  910 |       }
  911 |
  912 |       // Update tracking with indent level
  913 |       setListTracking(vNode.tagName, numberingId, indentLevel)
  914 |
  915 |       await buildList(vNode, docxDocumentInstance, xmlFragment, numberingId, indentLevel)
  916 |       return
  917 |     }
  918 |     case 'img': {
  919 |       const imageFragment = await buildImage(docxDocumentInstance, vNode)
  920 |       if (imageFragment) {
  921 |         xmlFragment.import(imageFragment)
  922 |       }
  923 |       return
  924 |     }
  925 |     case 'svg': {
  926 |       const svgSanitization =
  927 |         docxDocumentInstance.imageProcessing?.svgSanitization ??
  928 |         defaultDocumentOptions.imageProcessing.svgSanitization
  929 |       const verboseLogging =
  930 |         docxDocumentInstance.imageProcessing?.verboseLogging ??
  931 |         defaultDocumentOptions.imageProcessing.verboseLogging
  932 |
  933 |       const sanitizedVNode = svgSanitization
  934 |         ? sanitizeSVGVNode(vNode, { enabled: true, verboseLogging })
  935 |         : vNode
  936 |
  937 |       if (!sanitizedVNode) {
  938 |         return
  939 |       }
  940 |
  941 |       const svgString = serializeVNodeToSVG(sanitizedVNode as VNodeType, true)
  942 |       if (!svgString.trim()) {
  943 |         return
  944 |       }
  945 |
  946 |       if (svgSanitization && verboseLogging) {
  947 |         const validation = validateSVGString(svgString)
  948 |         if (!validation.valid) {
  949 |           // eslint-disable-next-line no-console
  950 |           console.warn('[SVG] Validation warnings:', validation.warnings)
  951 |         }
  952 |       }
  953 |
  954 |       const base64SVG =
  955 |         typeof Buffer !== 'undefined'
  956 |           ? Buffer.from(svgString, 'utf-8').toString('base64')
  957 |           : globalThis.btoa(svgString)
  958 |       const imageVNode = {
  959 |         tagName: 'img',
  960 |         properties: {
  961 |           alt: vNode.properties?.attributes?.title || 'SVG image',
  962 |           src: `data:image/svg+xml;base64,${base64SVG}`,
  963 |         },
  964 |       } as VNodeType
  965 |       const imageFragment = await buildImage(docxDocumentInstance, imageVNode)
  966 |       if (imageFragment) {
  967 |         xmlFragment.import(imageFragment)
  968 |       }
  969 |       return
  970 |     }
  971 |     case 'br': {
  972 |       const linebreakFragment = await xmlBuilder.buildParagraph(null, {})
  973 |       xmlFragment.import(linebreakFragment)
  974 |       return
  975 |     }
  976 |     case 'head':
  977 |       return
  978 |     default: {
  979 |       const tagName = vNode.tagName
  980 |       if (typeof tagName === 'string' && tagName !== '') {
  981 |         reportUnmappedType(
  982 |           { location: 'block', tagName },
  983 |           docxDocumentInstance.unmappedTypeHandling
  984 |         )
  985 |       }
  986 |       break
  987 |     }
  988 |   }
  989 |   if (vNodeHasChildren(vNode)) {
  990 |     /* eslint-disable no-await-in-loop -- DOCX XML fragments must be built in document order */
  991 |     for (let index = 0; index < (vNode.children || []).length; index++) {
  992 |       const childVNode = (vNode.children || [])[index]
  993 |
  994 |       await convertVTreeToXML(docxDocumentInstance, childVNode, xmlFragment)
  995 |     }
  996 |     /* eslint-enable no-await-in-loop */
  997 |   }
  998 | }
  999 |
 1000 | // Track consecutive lists to share numbering IDs
 1001 | // Use a map to track numbering per indent level: { 'ol_0': id, 'ol_1': id, ... }
 1002 | const listNumberingByLevel = new Map<string, number>()
 1003 | let _lastListType: string | null = null
 1004 | let _lastIndentLevel = 0
 1005 |
 1006 | // Helper to extract indent level from vNode or parent paragraph
 1007 | function getIndentLevel(
 1008 |   vNode: VNodeType | null,
 1009 |   parentVNode: VNodeType | null = null
 1010 | ): number {
 1011 |   // Check margin-left style which indicates indent level
 1012 |   const marginLeft =
 1013 |     vNode?.properties?.style?.['margin-left'] ||
 1014 |     parentVNode?.properties?.style?.['margin-left']
 1015 |
 1016 |   if (marginLeft) {
 1017 |     // Parse margin-left value (e.g., "24px", "48px")
 1018 |     const match = marginLeft.match(MARGIN_NUMBER_REGEX)
 1019 |     if (match) {
 1020 |       const px = Number.parseInt(match[1], 10)
 1021 |       // Assuming 24px per indent level in Plate
 1022 |       // Subtract 1 because Plate uses indent=1 for first level, but Word uses level=0
 1023 |       const plateIndent = Math.round(px / 24)
 1024 |       return Math.max(0, plateIndent - 1)
 1025 |     }
 1026 |   }
 1027 |
 1028 |   return 0
 1029 | }
 1030 |
 1031 | export async function convertVTreeToXML(
 1032 |   docxDocumentInstance: DocxDocumentInstance,
 1033 |   vTree: VTree | null,
 1034 |   xmlFragment: XMLBuilderType
 1035 | ): Promise<XMLBuilderType | string> {
 1036 |   if (!vTree) {
 1037 |     return ''
 1038 |   }
 1039 |   if (Array.isArray(vTree) && vTree.length) {
 1040 |     /* eslint-disable no-await-in-loop -- DOCX XML fragments must be built in document order */
 1041 |     for (let index = 0; index < vTree.length; index++) {
 1042 |       const vNode = vTree[index]
 1043 |       await convertVTreeToXML(docxDocumentInstance, vNode, xmlFragment)
 1044 |     }
 1045 |     /* eslint-enable no-await-in-loop */
 1046 |   } else if (isVNode(vTree)) {
 1047 |     await findXMLEquivalent(docxDocumentInstance, vTree as VNodeType, xmlFragment)
 1048 |   } else if (isVText(vTree)) {
 1049 |     const text = vTree.text
 1050 |     if (!text || !text.trim()) {
 1051 |       return xmlFragment
 1052 |     }
 1053 |     const paragraphFragment = await xmlBuilder.buildParagraph(
 1054 |       vTree,
 1055 |       {},
 1056 |       docxDocumentInstance
 1057 |     )
 1058 |     xmlFragment.import(paragraphFragment)
 1059 |   }
 1060 |   return xmlFragment
 1061 | }
 1062 |
 1063 | export function resetListTracking(): void {
 1064 |   listNumberingByLevel.clear()
 1065 |   _lastListType = null
 1066 |   _lastIndentLevel = 0
 1067 | }

 1069 | export function getListTracking(
 1070 |   listType: string,
 1071 |   indentLevel = 0
 1072 | ): { lastListNumberingId: number | null } {
 1073 |   const key = `${listType}_${indentLevel}`
 1074 |   return {
 1075 |     lastListNumberingId: listNumberingByLevel.get(key) || null,
 1076 |   }
 1077 | }

 1031 | export async function convertVTreeToXML(
 1032 |   docxDocumentInstance: DocxDocumentInstance,
 1033 |   vTree: VTree | null,
 1034 |   xmlFragment: XMLBuilderType
 1035 | ): Promise<XMLBuilderType | string> {
 1036 |   if (!vTree) {
 1037 |     return ''
 1038 |   }
 1039 |   if (Array.isArray(vTree) && vTree.length) {
 1040 |     /* eslint-disable no-await-in-loop -- DOCX XML fragments must be built in document order */
 1041 |     for (let index = 0; index < vTree.length; index++) {
 1042 |       const vNode = vTree[index]
 1043 |       await convertVTreeToXML(docxDocumentInstance, vNode, xmlFragment)
 1044 |     }
 1045 |     /* eslint-enable no-await-in-loop */
 1046 |   } else if (isVNode(vTree)) {
 1047 |     await findXMLEquivalent(docxDocumentInstance, vTree as VNodeType, xmlFragment)
 1048 |   } else if (isVText(vTree)) {
 1049 |     const text = vTree.text
 1050 |     if (!text || !text.trim()) {
 1051 |       return xmlFragment
 1052 |     }
 1053 |     const paragraphFragment = await xmlBuilder.buildParagraph(
 1054 |       vTree,
 1055 |       {},
 1056 |       docxDocumentInstance
 1057 |     )
 1058 |     xmlFragment.import(paragraphFragment)
 1059 |   }
 1060 |   return xmlFragment
 1061 | }
